title: First batch of Pinoy athletes off to Dakar for Youth Olympic Games
summary: The first batch of athletes from the Philippines is now on their way to the Youth Olympic Games in Dakar, having arrived in Istanbul early morning on Thursday after a 13-hour flight from Manila.
